summary: Post-rebrand (RealFlow → RealTraffic) backend verification. 35/35 tests GREEN: 17 new rebrand-specific assertions in test_rebrand_iter4.py + 18 iter3 regression smoke in test_clone_smoke_iter3.py — zero regressions. Confirmed: (a) /health reports admin_email_configured='admin@realtraffic.local' + mongo_connected=true; (b) NEW admin creds (admin@realtraffic.local/admin123) return 200 + is_admin=true; (c) OLD admin creds (admin@realflow.local) correctly 401; (d) /api/branding.app_name == 'RealTraffic'; (e) RUT POST validation: concurrency=20 → 400 with message mentioning '1..15' cap; concurrency=15 + fast_mode=true → 200 with concurrency=15 and fast_mode=true echoed back + job_id issued; (f) CPI module still mounted under /api/cpi (offers+dashboard/stats reachable, not 404). User register → admin activate+grant features → link create → RUT POST path fully works end-to-end. No backend 5xx anywhere. Skipped actual RUT job execution per request (Playwright chromium pre-install warning is pre-existing, non-blocking).

minor.issue: Returns 401 'User not found' when called with admin token because admin is env-only (not in users collection) and CPI uses get_current_user_with_fresh_data which queries the users DB. Not a regression — same behavior in iter_3. Admin cannot use CPI routes. Either (a) auto-provision an admin user row on first admin login, or (b) add a separate admin guard on CPI routes.

(Pre-existing from iter_3) route is on bare `app` not `api_router` so it bypasses /api prefix and is not reachable via public ingress. Only internal localhost:8001/health works. Move to /api/health or add ingress rule.

Proxy-required check fires AFTER concurrency check, BEFORE Target Mode / other validations. Currently if a user passes `use_stored_proxies=false` and `proxies=''` AND `upload_proxy_id=''` the error is 'At least one proxy required'. Good UX would be to mention the three alternatives (paste proxies / use stored / upload batch) in the 400 message.

action_items: (Optional) Move /health under api_router (or add ingress rule) so external uptime probes work.
(Optional) CPI route access for admin — auto-provision admin user row OR add an admin-bypass in cpi_module's auth resolver.
(Cosmetic) Improve POST /api/real-user-traffic/jobs 'At least one proxy required' error message to list all 3 proxy sources (paste / stored / upload batch).
(Pre-existing from iter_3) Pin bcrypt<4.1 to silence the passlib '__about__' warning flooding backend logs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~11959 lines — already flagged in iter_2 and iter_3. Rebrand touched 338 references across 50+ files cleanly, but the monolith makes future bug-surface-area huge. Split into routers (auth, admin, links, uploads, real_user_traffic, form_filler, branding, cpi-bind) should be scheduled.

Admin auth is purely env-based and never writes a corresponding row into the `users` collection. This leaks through every `get_current_user_with_fresh_data` endpoint as 401 for admin (CPI being the visible example). Either provision the admin user on startup, or make all feature-gated endpoints admin-aware.

RUT fast_mode is a good hardware-safety escape hatch — default OFF is correct for backward compat but the docstring should document it in /api/real-user-traffic/jobs OpenAPI schema (currently only in inline comment).
concurrency cap lowered from 20→15 is a BREAKING change for API clients sending 16..20. Response text correctly names the new cap; document this in CHANGELOG / release notes.

No ingress rule for /health means production uptime/liveness probes aiming at the public URL will silently 200 with the frontend HTML — false-positive green. Either /api/health or a K8s readiness probe against port 8001 internally is required.
